why: The story so far never establishes a household under the Derbyshire name. Derbyshire appears only as the name on a milliner's bill and as a friend of Straker's whose letters were sometimes addressed to the Straker house. Holmes calls him 'mythical' and says he could dispose of him, which undercuts any claim that a real Derbyshire household exists. The label's 'household' wording asserts an identity and setting the story has not yet supplied.
